messages:
tess: Short follow-up from the postmortem: we need a tightened playbook that reduces decision friction for oncall. Focus: a 6-step fast triage card, exact commands, and clear ownership. Keep responses short.

omar: I can own the triage card text + decision tree. Plan: one-line summary + 6 quick checks (service health, per-variant QPS, KV occupancy, recent evictions, recent config changes, mitigation). ETA Tue 2024-11-21. Owner: @omar.

felix: I'll add the exact one-liners for diagnostics and a tiny runnable script for oncall. Example snippet:
```
# one-liners
redwoodctl status --service runtime --env prod | jq .summary
redwoodctl metrics variant --route=chat --window=5m | jq '.variants[] | {name,qps,p99}'
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9090/debug/kv | jq '{used,capacity,evictions}'
# quick dump script (local)
set -e
redwoodctl metrics variant --route=chat --window=5m > /tmp/variant_metrics.json
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9090/debug/kv > /tmp/kv.json
```

anya: I'll handle the escalation bullet: exactly who to page and when, including Slack channel text templates. Rule: page eng-oncall when p99 > 2x baseline AND evictions > 0 for 4m. I'll add templates. Owner: @anya. Due Fri 2024-11-24.

cleo: Suggest a lightweight gating policy to add to the playbook: any routing weight change >12% must have a canary plan and a short pre-merge checklist (metrics to watch). I'll draft the checklist and owners. ETA Thu 2024-11-23. Owner: @cleo.

pm-bot: Note: playbook changes must have two reviewers (SRE + Runtime). Please include reviewers on PR.

tess: Good. Can we also create a single tracking ticket that links small sub-tasks and forces 90-day verification cadence? PM wants one place to check.

omar: I'll create RW-INC-6101 as the umbrella tracking ticket and link sub-tasks. Subtasks I propose: RW-INC-6102 triage card (omar), RW-INC-6103 diag script (felix), RW-INC-6104 escalation templates (anya), RW-INC-6105 gating checklist (cleo).

felix: I'll attach the runnable script to RW-INC-6103 and include a short test harness so oncall can run in staging first.

anya: For Slack page templates, I'll include 2 versions: one for "page now" and one for "informational" so product knows when to jump in. Example page body: "[ONCALL] p99 spike on chat route, evictions >0, running mitigation (fallback variant). See runbook: <link>".

cleo: For the gating checklist, I'll add explicit monitoring gates: p50/p95/p99, error-rate, and KV hit-rate; require SRE + routing signoff on PR. Also include a safe rollback command.

tess: Please include a short reproduction payload example in RW-INC-6103 so ML/product can try to reproduce the long-context burst pattern.

omar: Action list (capturing here so it's visible):
- RW-INC-6102: triage card + decision tree  owner: omar  due: 2024-11-21
- RW-INC-6103: diag one-liners + runnable script + repro snippet  owner: felix  due: 2024-11-22
- RW-INC-6104: Slack templates + escalation thresholds  owner: anya  due: 2024-11-24
- RW-INC-6105: gating checklist + policy text  owner: cleo  due: 2024-11-23
- RW-INC-6101: umbrella tracker (links & 90-day cadence)  owner: omar  due: 2024-11-25

pm-bot: Reminder scheduled: I will ping owners 72h before due dates and request reviewers once PRs are opened.

felix: One small oncall mitigation command we'll add to the card (no restart):
```
# set conservative sequence cap
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://console.redwood.dev/api/v1/runtime/config -d '{"max_seq":1024}'
# then switch route to fallback for immediate relief
redwoodctl routing set --route=chat --variant=fallback --force --note "oncall mitigation"
```

anya: I'll also add an automated small-notify step: when the alert triggers, post to #incidents with the prefilled template and include links to the triage card + diag script.

cleo: For rollout policy enforcement, I'll add a simple pre-merge GitHub action to check for the presence of a canary plan when a routing file changes; PR must include the monitoring gates.

tess: Great. Let's do a quick 10-minute alignment tomorrow to confirm wording and reviewers. I'll send an invite.

omar: I'll open RW-INC-6101 and create the subtasks after this thread. Posting ticket IDs here once done.

felix: PR draft link will be dropped in RW-INC-6103 when ready.

pm-bot: Thread will be archived after 72h of inactivity. Reminders queued.

tess: Thanks everyone. Update the umbrella ticket with PR links when available. If anything changes, reply in this thread.
